title: Split Filter Controller render branches
description: Extract complex filter render branches from FilterController.php into type renderers or a renderer registry without changing output markup.
objective: Make each filter type's PHP anatomy easier to evolve after the StyleControls split.
expected_outputs: FilterController.php reduced to orchestration and shared wrapper behavior: 100 lines
Renderer modules for wrapper fragments, sort, meta, and each filter type
Behavior-preserving markup contract verified by WP-CLI renderer characterization
acceptance_criteria: Rendered selectors and data attributes remain compatible with existing JS/CSS.
No filtering semantics change during extraction.
Renderer modules stay within DEC-EIT-014 line budgets.
verification: php scripts/verify-line-budget.php --strict passes; largest new renderer is 132 lines.
./scripts/wp.sh eval-file wp-content/plugins/elementor-implementation-toolkit/scripts/verify-filter-controller-robustness.php passes with 49 passed, 0 failed, and 6 Guilherme-owned visual QA skips.
WP-CLI renderer characterization passes for search, select, range, date, rating, toggle, checkbox, radio, chips, and swatch.
